clips.title: The story
paras: Lady Anacondra is one of the Fanglords leading the Druids of the Fang within the Wailing Caverns. Once a night elf acolyte named Scarletleaf, she was the first to volunteer for Naralex's ambitious effort to heal the Barrens. When her master's Emerald Dream communion turned into a nightmare, her mind broke, twisting her devotion into a venomous drive to see Kalimdor overrun by serpents.

Before adopting her serpentine title, Lady Anacondra was known as Scarletleaf. When the elder druid Naralex conceived of tapping into the subterranean springs of the Barrens through the Emerald Dream, she stepped forward as his very first volunteer. Her eager loyalty, however, proved her undoing. As Naralex's mind was seized by dark visions, the nightmare seeped out from the dreaming realm and contaminated his disciples, shattering Scarletleaf's sanity and reshaping her reverie into a cold, reptilian obsession.
